'''Brall Tavor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an figurehead of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] branch of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Brall and members from the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] were present during the [[Battle of Corellia|Imperial invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When the organized resistance began using rocket trams to battle against the Empire, [[Darth Decimus]] sent an Imperial hero to eliminate the weapon caches in order to seize Czerka's [[Hull-cracker|Hull Cracker]] weapon to use against [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. When the hero confronted Tavar, Brall was in holoconference with the CEC board members discussing the [[C-9X]] droid their companies had co-developed. Confronted, a terrified Brall handed over the Hull Cracker arming codes and begged to be spared but his pleas went unheard and he was executed.<ref name="Czerka" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brall Tavar is a character in the [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game.<ref name="Czerka" />

Brall Tavar can either be executed for dark side points or spared for light side points. If the latter option is chosen, Tavar will later sent the player a message, affirming Czerka's allegiance to the Empire.
